title: Choose the visual world for Night Moth
question: The roll assigned The Sighting Bulletin. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Sighting Bulletin
options.lineage: xeroxed moth-hunters' club bulletins and cryptid sighting zines, flash photos taken at 2am
options.thesis: Every night is an issue: the top ten are this week's confirmed sightings at the light, shot with a hard flash and logged deadpan.
materials: on-camera flash photography of moths on black
options.viewport: Masthead NIGHT MOTH with issue number; a giant flash photo of No. 1 on the lamp glass as the cover sighting; nine smaller numbered sighting frames; the Reward meter as the lead number; Buy $MOTH in the masthead.
options.risk: Can tip into loud tabloid if the copy shouts; the voice must stay a dry night log.

raised.raise: One full-frame inversion: the camera flash fires on scroll and the page flips to its negative for a beat.
Every sighting carries a leader-line callout with its exact balance and next Reward in ETH.
Registration crosshairs and a strict hairline grid frame every photo plate.
A sighting sharpens from motion blur only when you focus or hover it.
Escrow, Reward and Treasury read off one measured scale, never three meters.

options.label: The Light Sheet
options.lineage: lepidopterists' UV lamp and white sheet strung up in a dark field
options.thesis: The leaderboard is a glowing sheet in the dark: the closer a moth rests to the lamp, the higher its rank.
options.viewport: Black field, a luminous sheet hung on a cord filling the viewport, the lamp at top centre, ten moths resting on the sheet by rank, headline Stay in the light.
options.risk: The most literal reading of the name, and close to the near-black glow look many crypto pages ship.

options.label: Moon-shadow Bazaar
options.lineage: dream-surreal night market where shadows are traded
options.thesis: A moonlit lane where each of the ten moths is a stall casting a shadow sized by its holding.
options.viewport: One lane of stalls under a moon; No. 1's stall nearest the lamp with the longest moth shadow; tickets show balance and next Reward.
options.case: Holds audience identification (night, light, shadow); loses on clarity because stalls blur the plain ranking.
options.risk: Whimsy can bury the rank and the buy action.

options.label: Design Annual Plates
options.thesis: Holders as printed plates in an annual.
options.case: Fuses poorly: holders do not see themselves in a design annual.
options.kept: Registration crosshairs and a strict hairline grid.
options.risk: Cold and gallery-like for a memecoin.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.case: Loses both axes: no moth, no night ritual.
options.risk: Unreadable for a quick rank check.

options.label: Tensegrity Column
options.case: Loses both axes: engineering metaphor, no night or moth.
options.kept: Every element pinned to a measured value on a leader line.

options.label: Glyph-rain Terminal
options.viewport: Rain of glyphs with ten panes.
options.case: Loses both axes: the green-on-black crypto default, nothing of moths.
options.kept: Things sharpen into legibility only where you focus.

options.label: Oscilloscope Bench
options.case: Loses both axes: an instrument costume.
options.kept: Everything read off one measured scale.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean memecoin landing page: hero with ticker, buy button, leaderboard table, tokenomics cards.
canonCard.viewport: Mascot left, headline and buy button right, stats row under it.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other launchpad token by design.
